Xingcheng does not need to own many tool capabilities - tools are provided by governed tools and executors - but it must know how to call tools: emit valid star-tool-call/v2 calls with correct parameters, interpret tool results and handle errors and denials; every call routes through the information channel and permission checks, and tool results remain unverified inputs until validated.
Xingcheng never authorises or executes tools itself; tool-calling competence is part of maturity L6 and the Phase 6 acceptance.
star-tool-call/v2 (ToolContracts.cs, governed C# lane) is the single tool-call envelope; the retired Python tool_call_format.py (star-tool-call/v1) is historical-only. The L6 acceptance matrix and governed tool routing are still pending (Phase 6 / G3).

Complete pretraining data pipeline with eleven mandatory elements: Corpus Registry, Dataset Version, Language Classification, Source Tracking, License Validation, Unicode Normalization (with original-to-normalized mapping), Document Deduplication, Sequence Packing, Training/Validation Split, Token Count, Dataset Integrity. Language direction: Traditional Chinese primary, then English, programming languages, mathematics, science, general knowledge and reading comprehension.
Training data must be traceable, verifiable and reproducible. Confidential codex content (including the five zh-TW mirror parts and the codex database), permission data, Xingcheng private auxiliary channels, runtime state / audit journals and unauthorized data must never be added to a training set automatically (fail-closed); license validation precedes ingestion. Normalization must preserve the original-to-normalized mapping and must not damage code, paths, proper nouns or semantics.
The retired Python training/corpus.py is historical-only; the governed corpus pipeline is the native lane xcm_corpus.h (star-pretrain-corpus/v1) inside xc_modeltool with the star-corpus-registry/v1 source registry at runtime/settings/corpus-registry.json and the incremental star-corpus-scan-state/v1 contract verified by IncrementalCorpusContract; it lands all eleven mandated elements and enforces the exclusion rule fail-closed by path fragment and registry gate before any read.

Blockchain-style data structure only (append-only hash chain with verifiable integrity; no tokens, no consensus, no P2P): one module_id maps to one dedicated hash chain of operation receipts, state changes and version publications; entries chain prev_hash + payload_hash + actor/identity + decision/correlation id + timestamp into entry_hash, and any tampering, gap or reordering fails verification fail-closed. The design reuses the existing audit chain (GPTBridge.GitAutomation Ledger.cs chained audit append to git_audit_chain/, seal_manifest and revision_history) instead of creating a second ledger. Fine-grained modules each own a registry identity and an independent chain head; integrity verification (replay plus hash comparison) is provided and integrated with governor sealing and external signatures; chains store hashes and metadata only, never secrets or credentials.
Mandatory registered Codex contract invariant 20; a failed chain-integrity verification is fail-closed; history is never rewritten or deleted.
Recorded in registered Codex contract section 10.29 and invariant 20; the existing audit chain provides the mechanism, per-module chain heads are not yet wired.
